subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: After the code defect and proof gap are addressed, should this branch remain the candidate for the linked silent provider-error retry issue, or should maintainers consolidate on a newer sibling PR?
rationale: Several open PRs target the same root cause, none is currently a safe superseding target, and this branch is conflicting against current main.

options.title: Keep this branch after repair
options.body: Ask the contributor to refresh against main, fix current-attempt side-effect preservation, and add full-runner or gateway proof before another review.

options.title: Consolidate on a sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer a newer candidate, preserve any useful tests or proof context and move review focus there after it proves the same safety properties.

options.title: Pause all candidates
options.body: If the retry contract or harness result shape needs owner design first, pause merge work until that policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Keep this branch after repair
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to refresh against main, fix current-attempt side-effect preservation, and add full-runner or gateway proof before another review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and history place steipete closest to the embedded-runner retry and delivery-boundary decision.
